_comment: The Adventurer's Guild interior (16x12), reached via guild_door on the street (28,3; now a real door, not a toast). Selys RELOCATES here from the street (26,4) -- same entity id, her ENTIRE existing surface unchanged (talk_pool/talk_pool_stages/conversation graph), now standing behind a real desk (counter_left/mid/right at (6,2)/(7,2)/(9,2)/(10,2), gap at (8,2) for her -- same desk-gap convention as Erin's inn counter). Reuses the `inn` biome (Interior_Walls_01.png wood-hall look) rather than a new tileset -- both are wood buildings in Liscor; moods.json's `guild` card (warm bureaucratic) supplies the grade. THE REQUEST BOARD (guild_board) and a second guild_notice_wall prop are DRESSED-ONLY (on_interact_accomplishment + toast/observe, board copy lifted verbatim from docs/archive/staging/board-staging/board-copy.md sec.1) -- the real repeatable-posting mechanics live in THE REQUEST BOARD system, fed from guild-bounties.json (not touched here). Two Bronze-rank Drakes (Renn+Ilvo) bicker at the board -- a canon callback to the OLD guild_door toast's "adventurers arguing over a bounty board" -- plus a Gnoll archer (Yelra) at a side table; all three are talk_pool-only, inert-adjacent walk-ons (no quests/graphs v1), profiles in docs/design/character-profiles-staging.md. guild_exit (8,11) is the south-wall return door; guild_door's to_cell (8,10) lands one cell north of it (an entity's own cell is never a valid door landing -- the is_cell_blocked contract), facing up into the hall; guild_exit returns to street (27,3), the same open cell gate_district_walkthrough already stood on to approach the old guild_door prop, verified unaffected by Selys's removal.

floor_layers._pick: Reuses the inn hall's plank floor variant set (Interior_Walls_01.png) -- same wood-hall read as the inn common room.

segments._comment: South wall, gapped at x=8 for guild_exit.

decor._comment: Hotfix #5's own (8,4) block (rug_tan's real footprint, 80x72 @0.4 render_scale = 32x28.8px, ~2x2 cells, bigger than its single decor cell) turned out to crowd the ONLY straight approach to Selys's desk -- a real player reported a prop blocking the path behind her counter. UNBLOCKED again: the minor visual occlusion hotfix #5 traded against is the lesser cost versus genuinely obstructing an NPC approach; rug_tan is now non-blocking set-dressing like every other floor rug in this codebase (the window_blue flush-decor precedent). guild_interior_walkthrough/board_loop's own routes, which used to detour around this cell, now walk straight through it for real (positive proof the block is gone).

_comment_ambience: Same dusk/night-only dust-motes pattern as the inn hall (a deliberate judgment call, not an oversight).

entities.observe: A Drake behind a counter she clearly wishes were taller. Tired, sharp, quick with a ledger. She has sized up a hundred adventurers today and found most of them wanting.
entities.friendly_line: ...Huh. You're actually pleasant. That's rare on this side of the counter. Fine - your paperwork jumps the line today. Don't make it weird.
talk_pool: Guild's the usual mess. Bounties on the board, arguments over the board, somebody bleeding near the board.
Need something stamped, filed, or explained slowly? That is the job. Mostly the slow part.
Try not to die out there. It is a mountain of paperwork when you do, and guess who is the mountain.
New face. You'll fit right in - everyone here is chasing coin they have not earned yet.
entities._comment_stages: Lifted verbatim from docs/archive/staging/social-2-staging/selys_stages.json (staging_note annotation stripped). Two stages only. Board perk (⚑ first pick at the board) is FLAGGED unbuilt this wave (a repeatable board is new machinery, out of v1 scope per the staging doc) -- only the stage row + hub topic unlock ship.

lines: Oh good, a face that doesn't come with a complaint form. You can stand there as long as you like.
Tell Erin her letters are still too long. And that I read all of them. Do not pass on the second part.
Rough week on the board. If you're taking work, take the sane jobs. I flag the sane ones. It's not a service everyone gets.

entities._comment: THE REQUEST BOARD goes live -- `board: true` routes interact() to WIGame._interact_board (a browse-only, code-built dialogue: header + the CURRENT active slate's copy from data/bounties.json + footer). Toast is the DEFAULT header (board-copy.md sec.1's header line); second_visit_toast is the NEW variant shown whenever a posting is outstanding (sec.1's second header line). observe still carries the footer/standing-notice line verbatim (the S.S. signature -- Selys Shivertail; Tekshia the Guildmistress stays OFFSTAGE, a signature only, per the staged canon note) -- reused directly by _interact_board, not duplicated. Accept/turn-in live at Selys's desk (selys_delivery.json), per the copy's own framing ("taking a posting means telling me"); the board itself never mutates state. Sprite: bespoke `request_board` art (previously shipped on an `inn_sign` reuse, VISUAL-LOG flagged pending a real corkboard asset -- now closed).
entities.toast: The Request Board. Paper three layers deep in places. New notices pinned straight over the dead ones. Two or three have fresh ink.
entities.second_visit_toast: The Request Board. Your slip is still logged at the desk. The board does not care how it's going.
entities.observe: Rates set by the Guild. Complaints to the Guildmistress in person. Bring patience. — S.S.

board_rumors._comment: 8b R1 (issue #10) -- locked shape 1's Guild-board rumor beat. A DISTINCT, non-rotating list from bounties.json's pool (pool.size() is load-bearing for every canonical seed's times_slept modulo -- appending a live posting there would shift every existing board rotation window; a rumor is read, not accepted/turned-in, so it needs no picker/turn-in surface at Selys's desk at all). Shown on every board browse; _interact_board banks banks_accomplishment idempotently (record_accomplishment's own >=1 gate semantics, same as read_the_board's own every-visit bank). Future region milestones (#12/#16) append their own entry here, zero rotation risk.
board_rumors.copy: TRAVELER'S NOTE, pinned crooked. Village called Riverfarm, downriver a fair walk, farming folk, growing fast under some new lord. They've got witch trouble, or so the last one through here said -- crops going bad, nobody saying why out loud. No bounty on it, just word passed along. Ask the Guild about the road if you're curious.

board_rumors._comment: Locked shape 1's Guild-board letter beat, same idiom as rumor_riverfarm (a DISTINCT board_rumors entry, not a bounties.json posting -- that pool's size stays load-bearing for canonical rotation windows). Stays a SIGNPOST only: banks heard_of_invrisil idempotently on every board browse (_interact_board's existing >=1 semantics), a flavor-only counter no gate reads. The real invrisil_attuned banks from Eloise's stone purchase instead (riverfarm_witch.json's 'shop' node, gated on blight_lifted) -- the letter's own added clause points the player there, so the chain reads letter -> Riverfarm's quest -> Eloise -> Invrisil.
board_rumors.copy: A LETTER, sealed in wax gone slightly soft from handling, addressed to no one by name. Inside: impeccable handwriting regrets to inform you of a small disagreement in Invrisil concerning a mutual acquaintance's good name, and would consider it a personal favor -- and a professional one -- if a stranger to the city might look into it. The witch at Riverfarm keeps the stones, should the distance prove an obstacle. Signed only with a small drawing of a hat. The Guildmistress's clerk says it arrived by very ordinary post, which is itself the strangest part.

board_rumors._comment: 8d C1 (issue #14) 'What the Seal Kept' seeding beat -- SIGNPOST only, same idiom as rumor_riverfarm/rumor_invrisil (browse-only, banks a flavor-only counter no gate reads). Points the reader at Olesm by name (the stipend is HIS option, in olesm_intro.json, gated separately on post_game) rather than naming a location a player could act on directly from the board itself.
board_rumors.copy: A WATCH NOTICE, freshly pinned. The reopened gallery under the old seal is to be surveyed properly before the Council calls it settled -- volunteers with Guild standing should see Olesm Swifttail at the frontage desk. Pay is Watch-scale. The notice does not say what 'properly' means, and nobody pinning notices ever does.

board_rumors._comment: Issue #81 (exploration & optional content): POSTING-SEEDED hook for the_missing_recruit (data/quests.json) -- SIGNPOST only, the rumor_riverfarm/rumor_dungeon_survey idiom (browse-only, banks a flavor-only counter no gate reads). Points at Dresk/the barracks by name rather than naming a solution -- the real quest option lives on his own dresk_recruit.json conversation, gated on this same banked counter.
board_rumors.copy: WATCH NOTICE, pinned by a hand in a hurry. Recruit Pell missed second muster running. Ashgrave's not calling it desertion, not yet. Anyone with eyes free, ask at the barracks.

board_rumors._comment: Issue #81: POSTING-SEEDED hook for renns_warhammer (data/quests.json) -- SIGNPOST only, same idiom. Renn's own scrap tacked to the SAME board he complains about -- oblique enough that the guild_notice_wall's pre-existing 'Somebody wants a lost warhammer back' line (unchanged) now has a real notice behind it. Points at Renn by name; the real quest option lives on renn_hammer.json, gated on this same banked counter.
board_rumors.copy: A SCRAP OF PARCHMENT, tacked low, easy to miss. 'LOST: one backup warhammer, plain steel, no love lost between us but I want it back. Ask for Renn. Reward for the honest sort.' The handwriting gets angrier toward the bottom.

entities._comment: A second, smaller notice surface (city/personal notices, distinct from the Guild's own bounty board) -- ORIGINAL flavor copy, canon-safe (no invented named characters), voice-linted. Sprite: reuses `library_shelf` (a tall wood-shelf silhouette, tinted parchment) as a stand-in for a wall unit stacked with handbills -- VISUAL-LOG flagged pending a real asset.
entities.toast: A second board, smaller and less official: lost gear, room-for-rent scraps, one challenge to a duel that's clearly gone unanswered a long time.
entities.observe: Handbills and scraps overlapping the request board's edge. The Guild's actual business spills past its own furniture. Somebody wants a lost warhammer back. Somebody else is renting a room, quiet tenants only.

entities._comment: Renn Coldscale, Bronze-rank Drake, half of a bickering duo at the board -- profile in docs/design/character-profiles-staging.md. Reuses the `pc_drake_m` character-creation rig (ash-grey tint) rather than new art. talk_pool fires first-talk-of-the-waking as before; a REAL `conversation` (issue #81, 'Renn's Old Warhammer') now backs every talk after that instead of the old repeated-forever fallback -- gated content only (the 'ask' option requires guild_board's rumor_lost_hammer having been read), so no pre-#81 canonical (which never re-talks to Renn in one waking) is affected.
talk_pool: Four silver for a nest clear? Four? My arrows cost more than that if it goes badly.
Every posting on that board is an insult with a wax seal. I'm taking it anyway. Don't look smug.

dialogue.speaker: Renn
dialogue.text: Still four silver. Still an insult.

entities._comment: Ilvo Brackenhide, Bronze-rank Drake, the reasonable half of the duo. Reuses `pc_drake_f` (moss-green tint). Issue #80 (world reactivity wave, item 3 -- FLAVOR presence only, taste-gate 2026-07-12): present_when{phase:[day,dusk]} -- a pure talk_pool walk-on (no conversation graph, no quest/board tie -- Renn, the guild's OTHER bickering-duo half, is EXCLUDED from this wave, he's a quest-giver now via renns_warhammer), heads out with the rest of the Bronze-rank crowd once the board stops moving for the night.
talk_pool: He says that about every posting. Then he takes it. Then he complains the whole walk there.
The pay's fair for Bronze work. Renn just likes the sound of his own complaining.

entities._comment: Yelra, Bronze-rank Gnoll archer, waiting at a side table. Reuses `pc_gnoll_f` (tan-brown tint).
talk_pool: Bronze-rank, six months in. Long enough to know which jobs pay in coin and which pay in regret.
Quiet week. Short on the draws, long on daylight. I'll take quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Yelra
dialogue.text: Board's behind you, same as it was a minute ago.

entities._comment: Issue #81 'Renn's Old Warhammer' mini-quest (data/quests.json, renns_warhammer): the beat-1 discovery, a container prop (contains, the inn_chest/ruin_stones precedent) granting `renns_warhammer` (kind:parcel, data/items.json). No gate -- findable independent of ever asking Renn (a sequence-break is harmless here: `returned_the_warhammer` only ever banks from Renn's own gated turn-in option, so an early find just sits in the pack until the player talks to him).
